verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own site describes CHKit as typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code, which an agent can drive in CI. That is a first-party, agent-oriented command tool, but it is never explicitly called a CLI and covers only schema/pipeline workflows. Compatibility with stock ClickHouse clients is an ecosystem capability, and the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that CHKit is an installable official CLI, command reference/install docs, CLI coverage of cluster/service management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
